speaker_title: Statement by Mr. Amadou Ba, Minister for Foreign Affairs and Senegalese Abroad of the Republic of Senegal

paragraphs.text: Mr. President of the General Assembly,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President of the General Assembly,

paragraphs.text: Ladies and Gentlemen, Heads of State and Government and Heads of Delegation,
paragraphs.raw_text: Ladies and Gentlemen, Heads of State and Government and Heads of Delegation,

paragraphs.text: Mr. Secretary-General of the United Nations,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. Secretary-General of the United Nations,

paragraphs.text: At the start of my remarks, on behalf of His Excellency Mr. Macky SALL, President of the Senegalese Republic and People, I would like to extend my warm congratulations to the Republic of Turkey, for the decision to elect Ambassador Volkan BOZKIR to lead the work of the 75th Session of the General Assembly of the United Nations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At the start of my remarks, on behalf of His Excellency Mr. Macky SALL, 
President of the Senegalese Republic and People, I would like to extend my warm 
congratulations to the Republic of Turkey, for the decision to elect Ambassador 
Volkan BOZKIR to lead the work of the 75th Session of the General Assembly of the 
United Nations.

paragraphs.text: He has Senegal’s support and cooperation and I wish him every success in his august duties in the service of the Member States.
paragraphs.raw_text:
He has Senegal’s support and cooperation and I wish him every success in his 
august duties in the service of the Member States.

paragraphs.text: I also thank his predecessor, Professor Tijjani MUHAMMAD-BANDE, for his outstanding work in a most difficult context, marked by an unprecedented health crisis of Covid-19.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I also thank his predecessor, Professor Tijjani MUHAMMAD-BANDE, for 
his outstanding work in a most difficult context, marked by an unprecedented health 
crisis of Covid-19.

paragraphs.text: To the Secretary-General, Mr. António Guterres, I reiterate Senegal’s support for his continued efforts to reform the United Nations system, as the bedrock of more inclusive multilateralism.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To the Secretary-General, Mr. António Guterres, I reiterate Senegal’s support 
for his continued efforts to reform the United Nations system, as the bedrock of more 
inclusive multilateralism.

paragraphs.text: Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen,

paragraphs.text: Although we had planned to mark the seventy-fifth anniversary of the UN in grandiose fashion, we find ourselves in a virtual environment, physically separated from one another because of the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Although we had planned to mark the seventy-fifth anniversary of the UN in 
grandiose fashion, we find ourselves in a virtual environment, physically separated 
from one another because of the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: To paraphrase President Macky Sall, the infinitesimally small got the better of us. It is an unprecedented even in the Organization’s 75-year existence!
paragraphs.raw_text:
To paraphrase President Macky Sall, the infinitesimally small got the better of 
us. It is an unprecedented even in the Organization’s 75-year existence!

paragraphs.text: Accordingly, the theme chosen, entitled “The future we want, the United Nations we need: reaffirming our collective commitment to multilateralism — confronting COVID-19 through effective multilateral action”, could not be more timely, as it calls on us to take a clearer look at our shared challenges.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Accordingly, the theme chosen, entitled “The future we want, the United 
Nations we need: reaffirming our collective commitment to multilateralism  — 
confronting COVID-19 through effective multilateral action”, could not be more 
timely, as it calls on us to take a clearer look at our shared challenges.

paragraphs.text: Even more so than a progress report, the commemoration of the anniversary provides a meaningful opportunity to critically examine the Organization’s 75-year history, including its achievements, as well as its limitations, which hinder achieving current objectives.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Even more so than a progress report, the commemoration of the anniversary 
provides a meaningful opportunity to critically examine the Organization’s 75-year 
history, including its achievements, as well as its limitations, which hinder achieving 
current objectives.

paragraphs.text: With that in mind, I will address three major topics. First, I will speak about the imperative of finding a collective and united response to the global health emergency brought about by the COVID-19 pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
With that in mind, I will address three major topics. First, I will speak about the 
imperative of finding a collective and united response to the global health emergency 
brought about by the COVID-19 pandemic.

paragraphs.text: Secondly, given the uncertainty of the situation, I will discuss the need for the United Nations, whose mission is universal, to remain focused on its major priorities through its three main pillars of peace and security, sustainable development — in particular the climate emergency — and the promotion and protection of human rights.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Secondly, given the uncertainty of the situation, I will discuss the need for the 
United Nations, whose mission is universal, to remain focused on its major priorities 
through its three main pillars of peace and security, sustainable development — in 
particular the climate emergency — and the promotion and protection of human rights.

paragraphs.text: Lastly, I am going to share some lessons learned from Senegal’s experience as a developing country, particularly in the context of its pandemic response strategy.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Lastly, I am going to share some lessons learned from Senegal’s experience as 
a developing country, particularly in the context of its pandemic response strategy.

paragraphs.text: Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen,

paragraphs.text: The year 2020 will undoubtedly be remembered as a dark time, indelibly marked by the pandemic, whose devastating effects on every aspect of our lives have demonstrated — as if there were any need by now to demonstrate — our collective vulnerability.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The year 2020 will undoubtedly be remembered as a dark time, indelibly 
marked by the pandemic, whose devastating effects on every aspect of our lives 
have demonstrated  — as if there were any need by now to demonstrate  — our 
collective vulnerability.

paragraphs.text: At this time, I pay tribute to the memory of the hundreds of thousands of COVID-19 victims and wish the millions of patients sick with the disease a speedy recovery.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At this time, I pay tribute to the memory of the hundreds of thousands of 
COVID-19 victims and wish the millions of patients sick with the disease a 
speedy recovery.

paragraphs.text: Let us commend all actors who have taken up against this collective threat, in particular the health-care personnel, to whom I express my admiration and firm support.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Let us commend all actors who have taken up against this collective threat, 
in particular the health-care personnel, to whom I express my admiration and 
firm support.

paragraphs.text: To the international organizations, in particular the World Health Organization, which is responsible for coordinating the global response to this threat, I reiterate Senegal’s support.
paragraphs.raw_text:
To the international organizations, in particular the World Health Organization, 
which is responsible for coordinating the global response to this threat, I reiterate 
Senegal’s support.

paragraphs.text: Accordingly, my delegation calls for the effective implementation of the resolution adopted by consensus by the seventy-third World Health Assembly, particularly with a view to ensuring rapid, affordable, safe and quality access to essential health-care services and technologies, such as diagnostic tests, medicines and vaccines.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Accordingly, my delegation calls for the effective implementation of the 
resolution adopted by consensus by the seventy-third World Health Assembly, 
particularly with a view to ensuring rapid, affordable, safe and quality access to 
essential health-care services and technologies, such as diagnostic tests, medicines 
and vaccines.

paragraphs.text: We firmly believe that any potential vaccine or treatment developed in the fight against COVID-19 should be considered a global public good and made available to all countries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We firmly believe that any potential vaccine or treatment developed in the fight 
against COVID-19 should be considered a global public good and made available to 
all countries.

paragraphs.text: In addition, we must work together to ensure the availability of and access to essential health-care services, in particular quality primary care, which is key to achieving the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, especially Sustainable Development Goal 3.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In addition, we must work together to ensure the availability of and access 
to essential health-care services, in particular quality primary care, which is key 
to achieving the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, especially Sustainable

paragraphs.text: Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen,

paragraphs.text: The devastating impact of the crisis on our economies is indisputable! The collapse of economic growth and consequent dearth of sources of foreign exchange and shock to commodity prices, well as the decline in exports, investments and migrant remittances, have put the world economy in an crisis situation the likes of which have not been seen since the 1930s.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The devastating impact of the crisis on our economies is indisputable! The 
collapse of economic growth and consequent dearth of sources of foreign exchange 
and shock to commodity prices, well as the decline in exports, investments and 
migrant remittances, have put the world economy in an crisis situation the likes of 
which have not been seen since the 1930s.

paragraphs.text: Although it had initiated sustained growth dynamics, Africa, like the rest of the world, is suffering the full impact of the far-reaching crisis.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Although it had initiated sustained growth dynamics, Africa, like the rest of 
the world, is suffering the full impact of the far-reaching crisis.

paragraphs.text: Therefore, in order to ensure a proper recovery of our economies and ensure global sociopolitical stability, we will need to further focus on international solidarity and cooperation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Therefore, in order to ensure a proper recovery of our economies and ensure 
global sociopolitical stability, we will need to further focus on international solidarity 
and cooperation.

paragraphs.text: That is why His Excellency Mr. Macky Sall has called for the cancellation of public debt and the restructuring of private debt, as well as on developed countries to honour their commitments to official development assistance.
paragraphs.raw_text:
That is why His Excellency Mr. Macky Sall has called for the cancellation of 
public debt and the restructuring of private debt, as well as on developed countries to 
honour their commitments to official development assistance.

paragraphs.text: I would like to take this opportunity to commend the efforts made by the members of the G-20, the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund in support of the Debt Service Suspension Initiative.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I would like to take this opportunity to commend the efforts made by the 
members of the G-20, the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund in 
support of the Debt Service Suspension Initiative.

paragraphs.text: What Africa truly requires is not a debt moratorium, but rather debt cancellation in order to foster economic and social resilience, as well as build effective health-care systems.
paragraphs.raw_text:
What Africa truly requires is not a debt moratorium, but rather debt 
cancellation in order to foster economic and social resilience, as well as build 
effective health-care systems.

paragraphs.text: In that regard, the Secretary-General’s call for a large-scale multilateral response to marshal financial resources of at least 10 per cent of the world’s GDP deserves our full support, as it shows us the way to effectively address global challenges.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In that regard, the Secretary-General’s call for a large-scale multilateral response 
to marshal financial resources of at least 10 per cent of the world’s GDP deserves our

paragraphs.text: Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies, Ladies and Gentlemen,

paragraphs.text: During its 75-years existence, the United Nations — the quintessential symbol of multilateralism — has made great strides in promoting international peace and security, mutual understanding among peoples, sustainable development and respect for human dignity.
paragraphs.raw_text:
During its 75-years existence, the United Nations — the quintessential symbol 
of multilateralism — has made great strides in promoting international peace and 
security, mutual understanding among peoples, sustainable development and respect 
for human dignity.

paragraphs.text: This is evidenced by the many peace operations throughout the world, decolonization and the implementation of the 2030 Agenda, as well as the support and assistance that the UN provides to all people in need in the world, regardless of their origins or background.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This is evidenced by the many peace operations throughout the world, 
decolonization and the implementation of the 2030 Agenda, as well as the support 
and assistance that the UN provides to all people in need in the world, regardless of 
their origins or background.

paragraphs.text: Undeniably, the Organization has contributed greatly to the realization of our shared goal of bringing about a world free from the scourge of war, poverty and exclusion.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Undeniably, the Organization has contributed greatly to the realization of 
our shared goal of bringing about a world free from the scourge of war, poverty 
and exclusion.

paragraphs.text: We stand in need today of reinvigorated multilateralism and a reformed and effective universal Organization, as collective answers to our existential questions, so that no one is left behind.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We stand in need today of reinvigorated multilateralism and a reformed and 
effective universal Organization, as collective answers to our existential questions, 
so that no one is left behind.

paragraphs.text: Together, we can face the multiple challenges of terrorism, violent extremism, armed conflict, financing for development, illicit financial flows, migration, poverty, exclusion, public health and climate change.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Together, we can face the multiple challenges of terrorism, violent extremism, 
armed conflict, financing for development, illicit financial flows, migration, poverty,

paragraphs.text: In that regard, it is legitimate to ask why Africa remains the only continent that does not have a permanent seat on the Security Council, which devotes a large part of its agenda to the continent?
paragraphs.raw_text:

paragraphs.text: By hosting the ministerial meeting of the African Union Committee of Ten Heads of State and Government, entrusted with representing Africa’s voice on the reform of the Security Council, Senegal reaffirmed its commitment to the issue which, more than a moral imperative, is a way to revive the founding spirit of the Charter and its ideals.

paragraphs.text: Admittedly, Africa continues to face political and security challenges, which hinder sustainable development efforts.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Admittedly, Africa continues to face political and security challenges, which

paragraphs.text: In the Sahel, for example, terrorism and violent extremism have found fertile ground, with their resultant death toll, destruction of infrastructure and looting, thereby maintaining an environment of fear. All of that is against the backdrop of political and institutional instability, poverty, exclusion, porous borders and illiteracy, among others.

paragraphs.text: That state of affairs, however, should not obscure the other Africa, which is entrepreneurial, innovates, invents, succeeds and is admirably dealing with the COVID-19 pandemic in the face of the most alarmist forecasts.

The time has therefore come to seriously look at Africa in this light.

paragraphs.text: Indeed, there is no need to recall that climate change is having a devastating effect on populations, particularly in that it increases poverty, rural exodus, social exclusion and intercommunal tensions over natural resources.

paragraphs.text: In order to address the COVID-19 pandemic, Senegal has launched the Economic and Social Resiliency Programme with funding in the amount of 1,000 billion CFA francs, or $1.6 billion.
paragraphs.raw_text:

Economic and Social Resiliency Programme with funding in the amount of 
1,000 billion CFA francs, or $1.6 billion.

paragraphs.text: Supported through the financing of partners and donors, the Programme has made it possible to meet emergency and material health-care needs, assist households and the diaspora population, support the private sector, including through tax incentives, and ensure an adequate supply of fuel.

paragraphs.text: The Programme, which incorporates the SDGs, prioritizes health and pharmaceutical sovereignty, the resilience of populations and macroeconomic and financial stability.
